title: uCLI static schema manifest
description: Indexes the exact static JSON Schema files distributed with the installed uCLI package.

schemaSet.description: Fixed identifier for the uCLI static schema set.

packageVersion.description: Version of the MackySoft.Ucli package that carries this schema set.

protocolVersion.description: IPC and public execution-result protocol version implemented by the same uCLI package.

jsonSchemaDialect.description: JSON Schema dialect used by every document in the set.

schemas.description: Schema entries ordered by logical name using Unicode code-point order.

d0.description: Identifies one static JSON Schema document and its delivery relationships.

name.description: Stable logical name used by ucli schema get.

kind.description: Delivery and validation responsibility of the schema document.

path.description: Normalized slash-separated path relative to the static schema-set root.

$id.description: Canonical identifier that exactly matches the schema document's $id.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact schema file bytes as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

command.description: Matching CommandResult command for a CLI output payload schema; null for other kinds.

status.description: Matching CommandResult status for a CLI output payload schema; null for other kinds.

usages.description: Public command delivery sites for user-authored documents.

staticDependencies.description: Logical names of directly required documents in the same static schema set.

dynamicValidationSources.description: Public catalog commands used for dynamic validation after static structure validation.

d1.description: Describes one public command delivery site for a user-authored JSON document.

command.description: Public command that consumes or creates the document.

delivery.description: Method by which the command consumes or creates the document.

locator.description: Option name or fixed relative path used to locate the document; null for standard input.
